planned_against: Saved shared gamemd.exe on 2026-11-04. Each paragraph is appended after the function's existing plate; no earlier text is changed.
description: Corrects three notes the trigger-class audit found stale: they still said VERA had not ported code it now ports.

ops.text: The pre comments at 0x7015A2 and 0x7015AE that say "Rust: not ported, issue #758" are stale. VERA ports the RecordKill(NULL) call (0x7015A8) and the capture score (0x7015D2) in Simulation::change_owner_inherited (src/sim/world/mod.rs); issue #758 closed on 2026-10-10.

Corrects the VERA sentence of the first paragraph. The port is src/sim/combat/record_kill.rs. Since vera20k#3837 a House's losses are booked only here and by RegisterKill 0x703230, not at UnInit. ChangeOwner's call with no killer (0x7015A8) is ported in Simulation::change_owner_inherited (src/sim/world/mod.rs); issue #758 closed on 2026-10-10.

The 2026-09-11 paragraph's "complete live Tag event dispatch is still open" is stale. VERA raises event 31 through each tagged span cell's Tag in Simulation::dispatch_bridge_cell_tag_event (src/sim/trigger_runtime.rs), called from the bridge rim and ordinary-damage publishers.
